verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis II mission is set for launch as early as April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'scheduled to launch as soon as 1 April'; R3: 'Launch date April 1, 2026, 22:35:12 UTC'; R4: 'Artemis II lifted off... on April 1'; R5: 'pushed back... to 1 April at the earliest'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state or confirm the launch target as April 1, 2026.

verifications.claim: Artemis II will send four astronauts on a 10-day trip around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Four astronauts will take a trip... spend their 10-day mission'; R3: 'approximately ten-day trip'; R4: '10-day journey around the moon'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly describe four astronauts on a 10-day lunar flyby mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis II marks the first crewed lunar mission since 1972.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'first time in more than 50 years'; R3: 'first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972'; R4: 'humans had not left Earth orbit since Apollo 17... in 1972'
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation as first crewed mission beyond LEO since Apollo 17 (1972).

verifications.claim: Artemis II is part of the Artemis program.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis II, the first crewed Artemis flight'; R3: 'second flight of the NASA-led Artemis program'
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly place Artemis II within the Artemis program.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is a test flight.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'It is a test mission'; R3: 'The mission was a test flight supporting subsequent Artemis missions'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly call it a test mission or flight.

verifications.claim: Artemis IV is planned for 2028.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'target early 2028 for... Artemis lunar landing'; R4: 'Tentatively slated for 2028'; R5: 'Artemis IV mission would set out in 2028'
verifications.reasoning: Consistent targeting of 2028 across sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft's life support systems.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'checking the spacecraft’s vital life-support systems'; R3: 'crew evaluated life support... systems'
verifications.reasoning: Direct mentions of testing life support systems.

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'evaluating the performance of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket along with the Orion spacecraft'
verifications.reasoning: Explicit statement of evaluating SLS performance.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew includes NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, and Christina Koch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Commander Reid Wiseman... Victor Glover... Christina Koch'; R3: 'Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch'
verifications.reasoning: Names directly listed in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew includes Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Jeremy Hansen Mission specialist'; R3: 'Jeremy Hansen from the Canadian Astronaut Corps'
verifications.reasoning: Consistently identified as CSA astronaut.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission profile is a 10-day loop around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '10-day mission crammed inside... journey around the Moon'; R3: 'crewed lunar flyby mission'
verifications.reasoning: Described as 10-day lunar loop/flyby.

verifications.claim: Artemis II will set records for distance and speed beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'set the record for human distance from Earth...'; Flight Day 8: 'Artemis 2 won't break Apollo's speed record after all'
verifications.reasoning: Supports distance record but explicitly contradicts speed record.

verifications.claim: Artemis III is designed for testing.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'this new demonstration mission... will test one or both commercial landers'; R4: 'test out a crucial step'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly described as demonstration/testing mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis IV intends to land astronauts on the Moon's surface.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first Artemis lunar landing'; R4: 'attempt to land... on the Moon's south pole'; R5: 'land on the moon'
verifications.reasoning: Direct intent for lunar landing.

verifications.claim: Artemis I completed in 2022 an uncrewed lunar flyby.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis I Launched in 2022... uncrewed... lunar flyby'; R4: 'Artemis I (2022) was an uncrewed test... lunar flyby'
verifications.reasoning: Precisely matches description.

verifications.claim: Artemis I tested the SLS and Orion.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis I was the first... test of the Space Launch System and Orion'; R4: 'uncrewed test of the Space Launch System and Orion capsule'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statement of testing SLS and Orion.

verifications.claim: Artemis IV and V are aimed for 2028 and beyond.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis IV... early 2028... Artemis V... late 2028'; R5: 'Artemis V... in 2028'
verifications.reasoning: Both targeted for 2028, with subsequent missions beyond.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew includes the first woman to travel to the Moon's vicinity.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Christina Koch the first woman... to travel beyond low Earth orbit and around the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly states Koch as first woman.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew includes the first person of color to travel to the Moon's vicinity.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Victor Glover (an African-American) became the first person of color... around the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Direct identification.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew includes the first non-U.S. citizen to travel to the Moon's vicinity.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen the first non-U.S. citizen... around the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly first non-U.S. citizen.
